name: Daisy Cubes Are Strictly Realizable Ample
scope: Finite nonempty binary classes and their one-inclusion graphs.
statement: Every daisy cube is realizable ample, and the four-vertex path is realizable ample but is not a daisy cube in any orientation.
proof: The explicit daisy margin formula is positive. The four-vertex path is median and hence realizable; its degree pattern excludes a downset orientation.
